notes: Approved at the plan gate (2026-09-29) Premise (critique M-29, decision challenge): defensive. No build v2 database is claimed to exist, and E3 says there is no in-place upgrade; the "v2" prefix keeps a key stored by an unversioned request from replaying on /v2. Removing it would change behaviour for a migrated database, so it stays.

why.B: A key stored by build v2's unversioned POST would replay an InventoryItem body on /v2.
